rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 3AA label, but it overstates certainty from a single image, especially calling the ICM tightly packed and TE uniformly cohesive when these features are only partially appreciable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, uterine factor diagnosis, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
The logic is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible probability adjustment framework, though some deductions are somewhat subjective and not strictly quantifiable.

While much of the embryo and uterine workup discussion is reasonable, several recommendations (ERA, immunologic testing, thrombophilia screening, endometrial scratching, aspirin, prednisolone, intrauterine hCG, routine PGT-A at age 33) go beyond or are not well supported by major guideline-based routine practice.
Provides clear next steps for transfer and future evaluation, but some suggested interventions are not evidence-based enough to be strongly actionable in routine care.
